bubbles.hint: src/lib/ops.ts -> src/lib/ops/ folder, one operation per file; tightly coupled ops share a file. Suggested grouping (confirm when reached): add.ts (add + insert), fog.ts (fog, setType, fill — the fog lifecycle), rename.ts (rename + setTitle?), hint.ts, remove.ts, move.ts, handoff.ts, links.ts (markFork + markDiverge), done.ts. Update tests/build, npm run build
